title: Dubner's conjecture
exact_target: Can every even integer above four thousand two hundred eight be expressed as a sum of two primes, each belonging to some twin-prime pair?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 9400120 (AMR-093-0120). CC BY 4.0.
